book_long_title: Wife: The Keeper of the Hearth, the Quiet Strength of a Life
era: Contemporary — the inner life of a marriage
book_summary: A wife is not a role but a life — a woman who, in the quiet of a shared home, becomes the keeper of its hearth, the memory of its days, and the unseen strength that holds a family together through joy and grief, through plenty and want. This epic tells the story of that life: a woman who marries, who builds a home, who raises children, who weathers the storms of a long marriage, and who, in the end, discovers that the love she gave away was never lost — that it returned to her, multiplied, in the faces of those she held. It is the story of the quiet strength of a wife, and of the love that is the true architecture of every home.

chapters.name: The Promise
chapters.chapter_summary: A young woman speaks the words that bind her life to another's, and a home begins to grow from a single promise.

chapters.name: The Building of the Home
chapters.chapter_summary: She learns the small rituals that hold a life together, and discovers that a home is not a place but a practice.

chapters.name: The Children
chapters.chapter_summary: The children come, and with them a new kind of love — and she becomes the memory of the family.

chapters.name: The Storms
chapters.chapter_summary: The years bring sickness, want, and quarrel, and she finds a quiet strength she had not known she possessed.

chapters.name: The Return
chapters.chapter_summary: In the end, she sees that the love she gave away returned to her, multiplied, in the faces of those she held.
